# React Native Sync Provider — Full API Reference

> Cross-platform React Native Nitro Module that turns every HTTP request into a durable, offline-first job with native persistence and OS-scheduled background sync.
> npm: @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider
> Documentation: https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-sync-provider/

## Installation

```bash
yarn add @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider react-native-nitro-modules
# or
npm install @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider react-native-nitro-modules
```

Optional peers (recommended):

```bash
yarn add @react-native-community/netinfo react-native-mmkv
```

Requirements:
- React Native >= 0.74.0 with the New Architecture (Fabric + concurrent root) enabled.
- React >= 18.2.0.
- react-native-nitro-modules ^0.35.6.
- Android: minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, Kotlin 2.0+.
- iOS: 15+. Background Modes capability with `fetch` and `processing` selected.

iOS post-install:

```bash
cd ios && bundle exec pod install
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import {
  SyncProvider,
  useSyncQueue,
  useSyncStatus,
  useAutoSync,
  type SyncOptions,
} from '@gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider';

const options: SyncOptions = {
  strategy: 'AUTOMATIC',
  requestTimeoutMs: 30_000,
  maxQueueSize: 10_000,
  persistResults: true,
  historyLimit: 100,
  retryPolicy: {
    maxAttempts: 5,
    backoff: 'EXPONENTIAL',
    baseDelayMs: 1_000,
    maxDelayMs: 60_000,
    jitter: true,
    retryOnStatusCodes: [408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
  },
};

function Outbox() {
  useAutoSync({ flushOnReconnect: true, flushOnFocus: true });
  const { items, enqueue, remove, clear } = useSyncQueue();
  const { lastResult, isSyncing } = useSyncStatus();

  return (
    <View>
      <Text>Pending: {items.length}</Text>
      <Text>Last flush ok: {lastResult?.successCount ?? 0}</Text>
      <Text>Syncing: {String(isSyncing)}</Text>
      <Button
        title="Send event"
        onPress={() =>
          enqueue({
            method: 'POST',
            url: 'https://api.example.com/events',
            contentType: 'application/json',
            body: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'login' }),
            idempotencyKey: 'login-2026-05-05',
          })
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <SyncProvider options={options}>
      <Outbox />
    </SyncProvider>
  );
}
```

## Queue Functions

### enqueue

```typescript
function enqueue(item: SyncItemInput): Promise<string>;
```

Persists a single request and returns its assigned ULID. The native layer assigns `id` and `createdAt`. Throws SyncError with code QUEUE_FULL, INVALID_PAYLOAD, or INVALID_URL.

### enqueueBatch

```typescript
function enqueueBatch(items: SyncItemInput[]): Promise<string[]>;
```

Atomic batch enqueue. All items are persisted together or none are. Returns ULIDs parallel to the input array.

### removeItem

```typescript
function removeItem(id: string): Promise<boolean>;
```

Removes a pending item by ULID. Returns `true` on success, `false` if no item with that id exists.

### clearQueue

```typescript
function clearQueue(): Promise<void>;
```

Drops every pending item. Does not affect history.

### getQueueSize

```typescript
function getQueueSize(): Promise<number>;
```

### getPendingItems

```typescript
function getPendingItems(): Promise<SyncItem[]>;
```

Returns pending items in dispatch order with `id`, `createdAt`, `attemptCount`, and optional `lastAttemptAt` / `lastErrorCode` populated.

## Sync Functions

### flush

```typescript
function flush(): Promise<SyncResult>;
```

Forces a flush cycle. Returns the cycle outcome. May throw SyncError with NETWORK_ERROR, SERVER_ERROR, TIMEOUT, MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED, or UNAUTHORIZED. Per-item failures are also surfaced via `result.errors`.

### pauseSync / resumeSync

```typescript
function pauseSync(): Promise<void>;
function resumeSync(): Promise<void>;
```

Pause the dispatcher (enqueues still accepted). Resume schedules a flush if strategy is AUTOMATIC and items are pending.

### isSyncing

```typescript
function isSyncing(): Promise<boolean>;
```

## Configuration Functions

### configureSync

```typescript
function configureSync(options: SyncOptions): Promise<void>;
```

Replaces the active config. Takes effect on the next flush cycle; in-flight requests honor the previous config.

### getSyncConfig

```typescript
function getSyncConfig(): Promise<SyncOptions>;
```

## History Functions

### getLastSyncResult

```typescript
function getLastSyncResult(): Promise<SyncResult | undefined>;
```

JS facade returns `undefined` when no flush has run; the underlying spec returns a sentinel with `startedAt === 0`.

### getSyncHistory

```typescript
function getSyncHistory(limit?: number): Promise<SyncResult[]>;
```

Returns persisted results, most recent first. `0` (or omitted) means no limit.

### clearSyncHistory

```typescript
function clearSyncHistory(): Promise<void>;
```

## Connection

### getConnectionStatus

```typescript
function getConnectionStatus(): Promise<ConnectionState>;
```

## Background Sync

### enableBackgroundSync

```typescript
function enableBackgroundSync(options: BackgroundSyncOptions): Promise<void>;
```

Registers the OS-level periodic task (`BGTaskScheduler` on iOS, `WorkManager` on Android). May throw BACKGROUND_TASK_REGISTRATION_FAILED or NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE.

### disableBackgroundSync / isBackgroundSyncEnabled

```typescript
function disableBackgroundSync(): Promise<void>;
function isBackgroundSyncEnabled(): Promise<boolean>;
```

## Events

### addListener / removeListener

```typescript
function addListener(
  event: 'sync-event',
  callback: (event: SyncEvent) => void
): Promise<string>;

function removeListener(
  event: 'sync-event',
  subscriptionId: string
): Promise<void>;
```

The only supported channel today is `'sync-event'`. The native layer validates the channel name and throws INVALID_PAYLOAD on unknown values.

## React Hooks

### useConnection

```typescript
function useConnection(): { state: ConnectionState; isLoading: boolean };
```

Live ConnectionState that reacts to OS connectivity changes via the `CONNECTION_CHANGED` event.

### useSyncQueue

```typescript
function useSyncQueue(): {
  items: SyncItem[];
  enqueue(input: SyncItemInput): Promise<string>;
  enqueueBatch(inputs: SyncItemInput[]): Promise<string[]>;
  remove(id: string): Promise<boolean>;
  clear(): Promise<void>;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: SyncError | null;
};
```

### useSyncStatus

```typescript
function useSyncStatus(): {
  isSyncing: boolean;
  lastResult: SyncResult | undefined;
  history(limit?: number): Promise<SyncResult[]>;
  clearHistory(): Promise<void>;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
};
```

### useOfflineQueue

```typescript
function useOfflineQueue(): {
  isOffline: boolean;
  isPaused: boolean;
  pendingCount: number;
};
```

Pauses dispatch automatically when connectivity drops and resumes (with a flush) on reconnect.

### useSyncEvents

```typescript
function useSyncEvents(handler: (event: SyncEvent) => void): void;
```

Subscribes to the `sync-event` channel for the lifetime of the component. Unsubscribes on unmount.

### useSyncConfig

```typescript
function useSyncConfig(): {
  config: SyncOptions | undefined;
  update(next: SyncOptions): Promise<void>;
  isLoading: boolean;
};
```

### useAutoSync

```typescript
function useAutoSync(options?: {
  flushOnFocus?: boolean;          // default: true
  flushOnReconnect?: boolean;      // default: true
  intervalMs?: number;             // optional periodic flush from JS
}): void;
```

## Context

### SyncProvider

```typescript
<SyncProvider options={syncOptions}>
  <App />
</SyncProvider>
```

Wraps the app, calls `configureSync(options)` on mount, exposes the singleton hybrid object via React context, and is the required ancestor for every hook in this library.

## Types

### SyncItemInput

```typescript
interface SyncItemInput {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE';
  url: string;                          // absolute http(s)
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: string;                        // pre-serialized
  contentType?: string;                 // e.g. 'application/json'
  priority?: number;                    // higher dispatched first
  idempotencyKey?: string;              // dedupe + safe-replay key
  metadata?: Record<string, string>;    // user-defined tags
}
```

### SyncItem

```typescript
interface SyncItem extends SyncItemInput {
  id: string;                           // ULID, native-assigned
  createdAt: number;                    // epoch ms
  attemptCount: number;
  lastAttemptAt?: number;
  lastErrorCode?: SyncErrorCode;
}
```

### SyncOptions

```typescript
interface SyncOptions {
  strategy: SyncStrategy;
  retryPolicy: RetryPolicy;
  requestTimeoutMs: number;
  maxQueueSize: number;
  persistResults: boolean;
  historyLimit: number;
  defaultHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
  defaultPriority?: number;
}
```

### RetryPolicy

```typescript
interface RetryPolicy {
  maxAttempts: number;
  backoff: BackoffStrategy;
  baseDelayMs: number;
  maxDelayMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
  retryOnStatusCodes: number[];
}
```

### SyncResult

```typescript
interface SyncResult {
  startedAt: number;                    // epoch ms (0 = sentinel)
  finishedAt: number;                   // epoch ms (0 = sentinel)
  attemptedCount: number;
  successCount: number;
  failureCount: number;
  errors: Array<{
    itemId: string;
    code: SyncErrorCode;
    message: string;
    statusCode?: number;
  }>;
}
```

### BackgroundSyncOptions

```typescript
interface BackgroundSyncOptions {
  minimumIntervalMs: number;            // OS may schedule less often
  requiresUnmeteredNetwork?: boolean;
  requiresCharging?: boolean;
  requiresDeviceIdle?: boolean;
}
```

### ConnectionState

```typescript
interface ConnectionState {
  status: ConnectionStatus;
  type: ConnectionType;
  isInternetReachable: boolean;
}
```

### SyncEvent (discriminated union)

```typescript
type SyncEvent =
  | { type: 'ITEM_ADDED';        itemId: string }
  | { type: 'ITEM_REMOVED';      itemId: string }
  | { type: 'FLUSH_STARTED';     pendingCount: number }
  | { type: 'ITEM_DISPATCHED';   itemId: string; attempt: number }
  | { type: 'ITEM_SUCCEEDED';    itemId: string; statusCode: number }
  | { type: 'ITEM_FAILED';       itemId: string; errorCode: SyncErrorCode; statusCode?: number; willRetry: boolean }
  | { type: 'ITEM_RETRYING';     itemId: string; attempt: number; nextAttemptAt: number }
  | { type: 'FLUSH_COMPLETED';   result: SyncResult }
  | { type: 'CONNECTION_CHANGED';state: ConnectionState }
  | { type: 'CONFIG_CHANGED';    config: SyncOptions };
```

## Enums

### SyncStrategy
- `MANUAL` — Only `flush()` triggers dispatch.
- `AUTOMATIC` — Library schedules flushes after enqueue, on reconnect, on resume.
- `BACKGROUND` — Same as AUTOMATIC plus OS-scheduled background work.

### BackoffStrategy
- `LINEAR` — `delay = baseDelayMs * attempt` (capped at `maxDelayMs`).
- `EXPONENTIAL` — `delay = baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt-1)` (capped at `maxDelayMs`).

### SyncEventType
`ITEM_ADDED`, `ITEM_REMOVED`, `FLUSH_STARTED`, `ITEM_DISPATCHED`, `ITEM_SUCCEEDED`, `ITEM_FAILED`, `ITEM_RETRYING`, `FLUSH_COMPLETED`, `CONNECTION_CHANGED`, `CONFIG_CHANGED`.

### ConnectionStatus
`CONNECTED`, `DISCONNECTED`, `UNKNOWN`.

### ConnectionType
`WIFI`, `CELLULAR`, `ETHERNET`, `NONE`, `UNKNOWN`.

### SyncErrorCode
- `QUEUE_FULL` — Refused enqueue; capacity at `maxQueueSize`.
- `INVALID_PAYLOAD` — Item shape invalid (missing field, bad type, unknown channel).
- `INVALID_URL` — `url` is not an absolute http(s) URL.
- `NETWORK_ERROR` — Transport-level failure (DNS, TLS, socket).
- `SERVER_ERROR` — Non-retriable server status.
- `TIMEOUT` — Request exceeded `requestTimeoutMs`.
- `MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED` — Item exhausted its retry budget.
- `UNAUTHORIZED` — 401 / 403 response.
- `BACKGROUND_TASK_REGISTRATION_FAILED` — OS rejected `enableBackgroundSync`.
- `NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE` — `BGTaskScheduler` / `WorkManager` not available.
- `ITEM_NOT_FOUND` — Operation referenced an unknown id.
- `INVALID_CONFIG` — `SyncOptions` failed validation.
- `PERSISTENCE_FAILURE` — Core Data / Room I/O failed.
- `UNKNOWN` — Unclassified native error.

## Platform Support

| Feature                | iOS                             | Android                                  |
|------------------------|---------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| Persistence            | Core Data                       | Room                                     |
| Background sync        | BGTaskScheduler (`processing`)  | WorkManager (`PeriodicWorkRequest`)      |
| Foreground dispatcher  | URLSession (background config)  | OkHttp + Coroutines                      |
| Connectivity           | NWPathMonitor                   | ConnectivityManager + NetworkCallback    |
| Boot recovery          | OS task replay                  | BootCompletedReceiver + WorkManager      |
| Privacy Manifest       | Required (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy)| n/a                                      |
| Min OS                 | iOS 15                          | Android 7.0 (API 24)                     |
